originalSourceText:
Q.7   Which characteristic of a 7-DOF manipulator primarily enables effective collision
      avoidance?

      (A) Reduced actuator torque requirement

      (B) Multiple joint configurations for a given end-effector pose

      (C) Elimination of inverse kinematics

      (D) Increased workspace compared with every serial manipulator

       Explanation: (B) Refer Slide 3 of Lecture Manipulator Mechanism Design-II

      Unlike a 6-DOF robot, which has only a finite number of solutions for a pose, a 7-
    DOF manipulator offers  infinitely many solutions. This redundancy allows the
       controller to select configurations that avoid obstacles.
